Fictional claim · Ivo & Ada

FICTIONAL PUBLIC DEMO — all people, addresses and events below are invented.

I am Ivo Merin. My spouse Ada Merin and I share the apartment at Illustration Grove 12, apartment 3, Bern as our family home. On 6 October 2026 I personally received a registered item containing a tenancy-termination notice from our landlord. The letter proposed an end date of 31 March 2027. We dispute the termination and want the documents reviewed.

I attach our complete tenancy agreement and the original delivery record for the item addressed to me. I do not yet have a scan of the termination notice. Whether Ada received a separate notice is unknown; I have no such copy or delivery record.

We report no rent arrears or earlier tenancy-rights dispute. We have not decided about an extension and no hardship assessment has been completed. No challenge, settlement or outbound response has taken place. Please distinguish the recorded delivery from the unassessed legal validity and deadlines.
